about: T10 MAA verdicts (design section 3, unit U13c). Every expected value cites evidence outside the relay's code: MAA's own lines (gui log in the AUTO-MAS history, asst.log), AUTO-MAS's own result JSON, or a later run of the same week. Inputs: history/<date>/<stem>.log.gz (AUTO-MAS's copy of MAA's gui log) and asst/<file>.gz (MAA's asst.log cut to the window the relay reads, see SOURCE.txt). Verdicts: a history field is what parse_maa_log returns; 'alarm' is summarize(maa_checks(text), 'MAA') is not None; 'sanity_short' is maa_sanity_short(text). red_at and every also_red commit must fail an assertion and green_at must pass (test_gl_corpus_maa.py --prove).

cases.incident: 08-29 infrast failure recorded all green two days running; 08-30 first fix misread on_run_fails
cases.note: The incident's own conclusion (2771a49e) is that on_run_fails is a per-facility recovery, not a failure, so the right verdict on such a run is no alarm. ea143346 (first MAA check) and 2771a49e (reworded) still alarm on it; 701a6216 (judge by task-chain pairs) is the commit that turns it green. At ea143346~1 there was no MAA check at all, which also says no alarm, so ea143346~1 cannot be red on this input; no pulled asst.log holds a real chain failure under an AUTO-MAS 「Success!」 (searched 09-13..09-22 and 10-10..10-13: the only TaskChainError is a hand-run Copilot).

live_bugs.what: MAA prints a running total over 10000 rounded, 「龙门币 : 10.1k (+1440)」. collector_maa._DROP_ITEM needs digits, so that line also fails _DROP_ITEM_UNCHANGED, ends the block, and every item after it in that block and every later block keeps an old total (08-26: 龙门币 8640 instead of 12096, 艺人见面抽选券 720 instead of 1008).
